stops.name: Parque regional del Sureste
stops.detail: The Regional Park around the axis of the lower courses of the Manzanares and Jarama rivers, called Colloquially South-Eastern Regional Park, is a protected space of 31 552 hectares situated along the mid- low course of the Jarrama and Manzanares rivers, in the south-east (hence its name) of the Community of Madrid (Spain).
